x-abh-config.description: Explicit development profile; production capabilities are unavailable.
Test identity provider, usable only with Development.
Explicit environment reference for the restricted business runtime database role.
Separate environment reference for the queue database role.
Maximum database statement time, capped by the remaining request deadline.
Maximum database lock wait; cannot exceed the statement timeout.
Local business declaration entry; this contract does not load or execute it.
Action-only dependencies; Agent, model and learning runtimes stay disabled.
Maximum operations fixed when an Action is validated.
Maximum dependencies per node in the first Action profile.
Maximum lifetime of a proposed Action intent; shorter domain expiry still applies.
Bounded Outbox publication batch size.
Interval for Outbox polling in milliseconds.
Initial delay before observing an uncertain Operation.
Upper bound on reconciliation backoff; not a finality or expiry rule.
Workbench remains disabled until its implementation is available.
No project telemetry is enabled in this profile.

PackMigrationStructureBinding.description: Exact organization, package, migration plan and expected structure binding; not migration completion authority.
PackMigrationStructureBinding.title: PackMigrationStructureBinding

PackMigrationStructureReport.description: Signed structural expectation metadata. Does not assert actual database correctness or authorize Enable.
PackMigrationStructureReport.title: PackMigrationStructureReport

PackMigrationDataBinding.description: Exact organization, package, migration plan and declared data invariant binding; not complete domain verification or Enable authority.
PackMigrationDataBinding.title: PackMigrationDataBinding

PackMigrationDataReport.description: Signed declared data invariant expectation metadata. Does not assert actual data correctness or authorize Enable.
PackMigrationDataReport.title: PackMigrationDataReport

PackMigrationDataObservation.title: PackMigrationDataObservation
PackMigrationDataObservation.description: Actual declared data invariant observation. Signature describes the expected report, not a signature over actual rows. Validation checks representation and consistency only, never live database facts, provenance or Enable authorization.

PackMigrationStructureObservation.title: PackMigrationStructureObservation
PackMigrationStructureObservation.description: Actual bounded structural or combined inspection evidence. Validation proves representation and consistency only, not database facts, producer provenance, complete migration verification or Enable authority.

PackMigrationStateObservation.title: PackMigrationStateObservation
PackMigrationStateObservation.description: Actual bounded structural or combined inspection evidence. Validation proves representation and consistency only, not database facts, producer provenance, complete migration verification or Enable authority.

rowCount.description: Exact nonnegative PostgreSQL bigint count; never a floating-point number.

count.description: Exact nonnegative PostgreSQL bigint count; never a floating-point number.

groups.description: Exact nonnegative PostgreSQL bigint count; never a floating-point number.

PackMigrationNonApplicabilityReport.title: PackMigrationNonApplicabilityReport
PackMigrationNonApplicabilityReport.description: Checked no-change migration applicability report. Current signature, source and staged-content verification remain Owner obligations.

PackEnableProposal.title: PackEnableProposal
PackEnableProposal.description: Exact deployment-governance approval subject. Shape and digest do not prove approval or installation eligibility.

subjectDigest.description: Exact packageDigest of the Pack subject; not this proposal digest.
